::: {.hero-banner}
## A hidden public-health emergency — fix detection first {.hero-title}

**≈20,960 poisonings · 2,620 deaths · R2.34 billion lost — every year.** Yet South Africa formally detects fewer than 1 in 20 cases. **Strengthen surveillance, close the response loop, act on the worst product.**
:::

## The public-health problem in five lines

- South Africa records **2,620 pesticide-poisoning deaths per year** (StatsSA MACOD 2023, X40–X49) and an estimated **20,960 poisonings**, costing **R2.34 billion** annually.
- **Detection is < 5%**: NMC, NHLS, and PIH each see a slice of the burden; none sees the whole. Decision-makers act on the visible 1,013 NMC notifications while the other ~95% remain invisible.
- The **response loop is broken**: ~99% of notifications end without a recorded investigation, referral, or regulatory follow-up.
- **One product** — **terbufos**, WHO Class Ia — dominates fatal paediatric pesticide poisoning (Davies 2023) and remains freely registered.
- **96% of the cost falls on households** (lost lifetime earnings), but the only people who can change the upstream exposure sit in DALRRD and NDoH.

::: {.callout-important icon=false}
## Why surveillance is step one
You cannot prioritise, target, or evaluate a response to a problem you cannot see. **Detection is the precondition for credible action on coordination and on terbufos.** The Surveillance MVP costs ~R137k/year, takes 12 weeks, and lifts per-case detection from 4.8% to 18.9% — a ≈4× uplift using assets that already exist (NMC, NHLS BChE, PIH).
:::

## The headline numbers

| Indicator | Value | Source |
|:----------|------:|:-------|
| Annual deaths (canonical) | **2,620** | StatsSA MACOD 2023, Table 4.12 (X40–X49) |
| True annual burden (mid-CFR) | **~20,960 cases** | StatsSA ÷ 12.5 % CFR |
| Currently detected (NMC) | **1,013 (4.8 %)** | NICD NMC Annual Report 2023 |
| Annual economic burden | **R2.34 billion** | Morbidity (R90M) + mortality (R2.25B) |
| Health-sector share (NDoH + NHLS) | **~R80M (3.4 %)** | Direct budget-line cost |
| Household / societal share | **~R2.26B (96.6 %)** | OOP + lost lifetime earnings |

## The three briefs — sequenced

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### 1 · [Detect](posts/surveillance_policy.qmd) — *start here*

**Surveillance brief.** Close the gap between NMC, NHLS, and PIH so cases are seen in days, not weeks. **You cannot act on what you cannot see.**

**MVP — ~R137k/year, detection 4.8% → 18.9%, 12 weeks.**
NHLS→NMC feed (live) + BChE auto-notify + PIH dashboard / minimum viable dataset.

*Audience: NDoH, NICD, NHLS, MAC.*
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### 2 · [Act](posts/coordination_policy.qmd)

**Coordination brief.** Make every NMC notification trigger a recorded EHP investigation and a DALRRD-acknowledged referral.

**Full Package — ~R145k/year, ~957 deaths averted/year at scale.**
Closure-of-loop field + structured DALRRD referral + NICD→DALRRD intelligence feed + clinician feedback + joint KPI dashboard.

*Audience: NDoH + DALRRD DGs, MAC, Treasury.*
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### 3 · [Restrict](posts/terbufos_policy.qmd)

**Terbufos brief.** Act on the WHO Class Ia product driving a disproportionate share of fatal pesticide poisonings.

**Option T2 now; 24-month evaluation gate to T3 (full ban).**
DALRRD-led; ~R1–3M/year of enforcement retires household-borne mortality cost at a leverage ratio of **~500 : 1**.

*Audience: DALRRD Pesticide Registrar, MAC, NDoH.*
:::

:::

## How the three briefs work as one system

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-golden-thread
%%| fig-cap: "Golden thread of the D2P briefs. Surveillance comes first because it is the precondition for credible action on the other two. Better detection generates the evidence the coordination loop needs; the closed loop terminates in product-specific regulatory action (starting with terbufos); outcomes of that action are picked up by the same surveillance system that started the chain."
flowchart LR
    S[1 · Detect<br/><b>Surveillance</b><br/>NMC + NHLS + PIH<br/><i>FIRST STEP</i>] --> C[2 · Act<br/><b>Coordination</b><br/>NICD → EHP → DALRRD]
    C --> R[3 · Restrict<br/><b>Terbufos</b><br/>RUP → 24-month gate → ban]
    R -.Outcome<br/>feedback.-> S

    style S fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#0050a0,stroke-width:3px
    style C fill:#9f9,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style R fill:#ffd9b3,stroke:#cc8800,stroke-width:2px
```

Three stages, one system. Each affordable on its own; each strictly more valuable paired with the others. **Total annual operating cost ~R280k against an annual burden of R2.34 billion (~1,000× ROI on the narrow case).**

## What this site does *not* claim

- **A new legislative ask.** Every recommendation is implementable under existing authority (NHA §90; Act 36 of 1947).
- **Unsourced numbers.** Every figure traces back to [`amua_import_parameters_v4.csv`](amua_import_parameters_v4.csv) and the references in the [Parameters Hub](parameters_hub.qmd).
- **A single point estimate masquerading as certainty.** Headline numbers are anchored to ranges; open evidence gaps are listed explicitly.
